A small bit or portion, a particle, an atom, a very small quantity;
 क्लेश (v. l. स्वेद) -लेशैरभिन्नम् Ś. 2. 4; श्रमवारिलेशैः
A measure of time (equal to two kalās).

(In Rhet.) A figure of speech which consists in representing what is
 usually considered as an advantage to be a disadvantage and vice versa.
 It is thus defined in R. G.:− गुणस्यानिष्टसाधनतया दोषत्वेन दोषस्येष्टसाधनतया
 गुणत्वेन च वर्णनं लेशः; for examples see ad loc. (Mammaṭa
 appears to include this figure under विशेष. See K.
+ -उक्त a. only suggested, or hinted at, insinuated.

A clod, lump of earth.
